question: How many kūṭas constitute the great vidyā of Tripurā in this formulation?
premises: It is called the great vidyā.
It is formed of eleven kūṭas.
inference: The great vidyā of Tripurā is structured as an eleven-kūṭa composition.
plain_english: The great vidyā of Tripurā is formed of eleven kūṭas.
